flavor_text: A sturdy suit of armor covered in a thin layer of ice and infused with the power of cold. It seems to have been left on the ocean floor and taken on the properties of the freezing, forbidding depths.
notes: This item was modified by Update 14. Pre-U14 is ML 7, different values for armor bonus, hardness, durability, and base value.
